title: Covariance and Principal Component Analysis on Riemannian Manifolds and Graphs
summary: We develop notions of covariance and principal component analysis (PCA) for probability measures on Riemannian manifolds of bounded geometry and a discrete counterpart for distributions on the vertex sets of weighted simple graphs. Rather than anchoring variation at the Fréchet mean, whose uniqueness and usefulness can fail in this context, we consider variation about every point.
